This is a traditional dish from Israel and is often served at barbecues and parties.  The recipe is very simple and can be adapted to your own taste.

Ingredients

1 cup of flour

1/2 cup of milk

1/2 cup of water

2 eggs

1/2 teaspoon of salt

1/4 teaspoon of baking powder

2 cups of grated cheddar cheese
